name: craftsman
description: Ship something with Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, Claude Code, or Codex and it works, but nobody with an engineering background has checked it. craft-audit audits the whole project for production readiness across ten areas (UX, frontend, backend, database, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint, AI integrations), not just security. Findings are ranked by real consequence, not alphabetically, so a broken invoice check beats a missing comment. The craft-fix companion drives the fixes but can never mark its own work fixed.

interface.shortDescription: The engineering review you'd get from the technical co-founder you don't have
interface.longDescription: Ship something with Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, Claude Code, or Codex and it works, but no engineer has checked it yet. This audits the whole project the way one would: UX, frontend, backend, database, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint, and AI integrations. Findings are ranked by real consequence, so a broken invoice check beats a missing comment; security is one of ten areas here, not the whole check. Everything lands in a workspace inside your project so a long audit can pause and resume. The fixer companion drives the fixes but can never mark its own work fixed; only a fresh audit pass can confirm that.
defaultPrompt: Is my app production-ready before I let real customers in?
What would a senior engineer flag in this project?
Audit this repo across all ten areas and prioritize the highest-risk fixes
